import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n = int(data[0])
q = int(data[1])

painters = []
index = 2
for _ in range(q):
    l = int(data[index]) - 1
    r = int(data[index + 1]) - 1
    painters.append((l, r))
    index += 2

# Calculate full coverage using all painters
coverage = [0] * n
for l, r in painters:
    for i in range(l, r + 1):
        coverage[i] += 1

# Calculate the number of painted sections when we hire all painters
total_painted = sum(1 for x in coverage if x > 0)

# Try removing each pair of painters and track the maximum result
max_painted = 0

for i in range(q):
    for j in range(i + 1, q):
        # Remove painters i and j
        temp_coverage = coverage[:]
        for l in range(painters[i][0], painters[i][1] + 1):
            temp_coverage[l] -= 1
        for r in range(painters[j][0], painters[j][1] + 1):
            temp_coverage[r] -= 1
        
        # Count the number of painted sections
        painted_with_removal = sum(1 for x in temp_coverage if x > 0)
        
        # Update max_painted
        max_painted = max(max_painted, painted_with_removal)

print(max_painted)

import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n, q = map(int, data[:2])
painters = [tuple(map(int, data[i:i+2])) for i in range(2, 2+q)]

painters.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

max_painted = 0
for i in range(q):
    for j in range(i+1, q):
        painted = sum(1 for x in range(1, n+1) if any(l <= x <= r for l, r in [painters[i], painters[j]]))
        max_painted = max(max_painted, painted)

print(max_painted)
